meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取 migrate-v2.sh 留下的 handoff.json,接着把 v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾:确认 v2 能收发真实消息、给 owner 授权、迁移旧记忆、核对容器配置,并协助移植 fork 里的自定义代码。
howto.when: 在终端跑完 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 之后接管;当你提到 “migrate from v1”、“finish migration” 等关键词时也会触发。若 handoff.json 不存在,它会让你先去终端跑那个脚本。

say.text: 继续完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移
say.note: 先读 handoff.json,再按阶段往下做

say.text: 帮我把 owner 权限授予我的账号
say.note: 查 user_roles,缺 owner 就补上

say.text: 帮我把导入群组的旧记忆迁移过来
say.note: 它会针对这些群组运行 /migrate-memory

howto.what_en: After migrate-v2.sh finishes, Claude reads its handoff.json and completes the v1→v2 migration: verifies v2 routes real messages, seeds the owner role, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port fork customizations.
howto.when_en: Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes in your terminal, or when you mention "migrate from v1", "finish migration" etc. If handoff.json is missing, it tells you to run that script first.

say_en.text: Finish the v1 to v2 migration
say_en.note: Reads handoff.json, then works through the phases

say_en.text: Grant my account the owner role
say_en.note: Checks user_roles and grants owner if missing

say_en.text: Migrate the legacy memory for my groups
